title: The **Prime-Embedded Quantum J Multiplicity Algorithm (PEQJMA)** introduces **prime-number encoding** into the framework of **angular momentum algebra** (denoted by J operators) and **quantum multiplicity**. In quantum mechanics, **angular momentum** plays a crucial role in describing the rotational symmetries of quantum systems, whether these are **orbital angular momentum**, **spin angular momentum**, or the **total angular momentum** of particles. The operators JxJ\_xJx​, JyJ\_yJy​, and JzJ\_zJz​ represent the angular momentum components, while J2J\^2J2 gives the total angular momentum.
